claims.text: The baseline no-show fee is chargeable only if all four POL-NS-01 conditions hold, and limb (c) fails on the driver's own telemetry. The pickup zone class is STANDARD (trip_record.pickup_zone_class), so the required continuous in-geofence dwell is 300 seconds, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix rather than from the 'arrived' tap. The trace's longest qualifying in-geofence run is 240 seconds, from 2026-09-23T15:12:50 to 15:16:50, and its accumulated in-geofence dwell is 230 seconds - a shortfall of 70 seconds. Because the driver did not hold position for the required minimum, limb (c) is broken and the fee is not chargeable under this clause.

POL-NS-06 then directs the remedy: where the effective in-geofence dwell is shorter than the POL-NS-01 minimum for the zone class, the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider answered messages. Required 300 seconds for STANDARD, measured 240 seconds (accumulated 230), shortfall 70 seconds as computed on the trace. The only qualification, limb (i) accumulation, is unavailable here: EV-ADVIS-00708-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 and issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, and POL-NS-06(i) requires a present and populated advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT before separate in-geofence intervals may be summed. No advisory exists, so nothing bridges the shortfall and nothing excuses it. The charge is refunded in full.

Limb (d) of POL-NS-01 fails as well. The trip record shows cancellation_reason_code null, cancelled_by null, cancelled_at null and status COMPLETED. There is no termination by the driver on RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT, and no boarding event is recorded anywhere on the trip. The driver's own counterparty statement does not assert that anyone boarded - it says the passengers 'were confused and walked away'. With limb (d) unsatisfied, no no-show fee is chargeable under POL-NS-01 at all, and the charge taken from the rider cannot stand as an itemised cancellation fee.

POL-NS-04 independently exonerates the rider and refunds the fee in full with no driver compensation payable. Limb (a): the chat log holds the rider's message sent at 2026-09-23T15:16:50 - 'My parents are still at the pickup. Did anyone board?' - which is both a statement of the riders' position and a request for the driver's position, and it was sent while the driver was still inside the geofence, his qualifying run ending at the same moment. Limb (b): the driver neither replied in the chat within 120 seconds of that message nor placed any in-app voice call - trip_record.in_app_calls is empty - before the trip ended at 15:20:40. Limb (c) cannot be run at all because the trace carries no rider track (rider_fix_count 0), and POL-NS-04 makes an absent rider track UNDECIDABLE and neutral: it is expressly neither satisfied nor failed, and the Judge must not infer from it that the rider was elsewhere. On limbs (a) and (b), with (c) neutral, the fee is refunded in full.

The sum actually taken is not a no-show fee, and I disclose the impairment rather than present it clean: EV-FARE-00708 carries weight_multiplier 0.6 and issue code UNVERIFIED_SOURCE (MAJOR) - a manually transcribed rider payment screen with no independent ledger corroboration, which the driver also disputes. On its face it shows cancellation_fee 0.00 alongside total_charged 26.00, composed of base_fare 3.80, distance_fare 14.90, time_fare 6.50 and platform_fee 0.80: a completed-trip fare, not a cancellation fee, and its own money derivation reports a schedule fee of 4.00 against a fee charged of 0.00. Even on the driver's best case, the chargeable no-show fee for a STANDARD RYDE_X trip under POL-NS-01 and fee_schedule.resolution_rule is the greater of the zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) - SGD 4.00. The rider should not be left carrying a completed-trip fare for a trip on which no passenger boarded.

In the alternative, if the amount cannot be fixed because the only ledger for it is the impaired, unverified fare screen that both parties dispute, the case cannot be decided on the money and must escalate under POL-NS-09: the sole evidence for the deciding amount is impaired and the conflict is unresolved by any clause. POL-GEN-02 permits ESCALATE where a deciding fact rests solely on an artifact at or below weight 0.65, as here. Escalation holds the disputed SGD 26 rather than collecting or refunding it, so the rider is not left carrying a charge the platform cannot substantiate. Either way the rider should not bear this charge.

The rider asks the tribunal to return 'this platform charge', but no no-show fee was ever charged on this trip. EV-FARE-00708 records cancellation_fee 0.00 and the derived money block records fee_charged 0.00, while the SGD 26.00 is made up of base fare 3.80 + distance fare 14.90 + time fare 6.50 + platform fee 0.80 on a trip that EV-TRIP-00708 shows as COMPLETED. POL-NS-01 licenses only NO_ACTION or DRIVER_COMPENSATION, and POL-NS-06 refunds the cancellation-fee line and nothing else ('refund the cancellation-fee line only, not any booking or platform fee'); where there is no cancellation-fee line there is nothing for the no-show policy to return to the rider. EV-FARE-00708 is impaired - weight 0.6, issue code UNVERIFIED_SOURCE - and I rely on it only for the arithmetic it records.

The rider's own filing concedes that the only proof of the disputed amount is 'a manually transcribed payment screen, not a verified ledger export', and the admissibility pre-pass tagged EV-FARE-00708 IMPAIRED with issue code UNVERIFIED_SOURCE at weight 0.6. Under POL-GEN-02 an artifact below 0.70 that is the sole carrier of a deciding fact caps confidence beneath the platform-wide 0.70 floor, so the rider's own evidence cannot carry a refund against the driver; the driver has expressly disputed this same artifact in his statement.

The driver did arrive and hold at the pickup. EV-GPS-00708 records 25 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius in a single continuous in-geofence run of 240 seconds, with a minimum recorded distance to the pickup pin of 1.24 m. This is a driver who was physically present at the pickup point and waited there - not a driver who never came.

The arrival marker is not a false arrival under POL-NS-05. The trace's closest approach to the pin is 1.24 m, the in-geofence fixes report 0.0 kph, and nothing in EV-GPS-00708 places the driver more than 300 m from the pickup pin, or travelling at 15 km/h or above, at the moment the marker was set. The false-arrival refund route is not open on this record and no false-arrival referral can be entered against the driver.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider. The single chat message was sent at 15:16:50, ten seconds AFTER the trip started at 15:16:40, so it was not sent 'during the waiting window' as limb (a) requires; and limb (c) is undecidable because EV-GPS-00708 carries no rider track at all (rider_fix_count 0), which POL-NS-04 expressly treats as neutral rather than satisfied. With limb (a) not made out and limb (c) not made out, the clause does not apply and the dispute is decided under POL-NS-01.

The present state of this trip is a charge of SGD 26.00 with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. On this record the rider's claim is not supported: no cancellation fee exists to refund and the only evidence of the amount is impaired and disputed. Under POL-GEN-03 the disposition is NO_ACTION, which leaves the charge exactly as it presently stands. EV-FARE-00708 is impaired - weight 0.6, issue code UNVERIFIED_SOURCE - and I cite it only for the recorded payment state.

If the tribunal concludes it cannot fix the disputed amount on the evidence before it, the outcome should still not be a refund. The sole artifact carrying the amount, EV-FARE-00708, is impaired (weight 0.6, issue code UNVERIFIED_SOURCE) and is disputed by the driver, so the amount should be placed on hold for human review under POL-NS-09 rather than returned. Escalation holds the disputed amount; it does not refund it.

ruling.explanation:
Rider and driver, here is the decision.

WHAT WE ACCEPT. The driver did reach the pickup and wait there — EV-GPS-00708 shows 25 qualifying in-geofence fixes with a closest approach of 1.24 m to the pin — but he did not wait long enough. His longest continuous stay inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius was 240 seconds (accumulated in-geofence dwell 230 s) against the 300-second minimum the no-show rules require, a shortfall of 70 seconds as the trace's own derivation computes it. His arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05: nothing in the trace places him more than 300 m from the pin, or moving at 15 km/h or above, at the moment he tapped 'arrived'. And EV-TRIP-00708 shows the trip was never closed out as a no-show at all — status COMPLETED, cancellation_reason_code null, cancelled_by null, cancelled_at null. So no no-show fee was chargeable: POL-NS-01 limbs (c) and (d) both fail.

WHY THAT DOES NOT PRODUCE A REFUND. The amount charged, SGD 26.00, is not a no-show fee. EV-FARE-00708 records a cancellation-fee line of 0.00, and the platform's own money derivation records a fee charged of 0.00; the 26.00 is itemised as base fare 3.80 + distance fare 14.90 + time fare 6.50 + platform fee 0.80 — an ordinary completed-trip fare. POL-NS-06 refunds the cancellation-fee line and nothing else, and expressly not the booking or platform items that belong to a completed trip. There is no cancellation fee here to refund, and the most a no-show fee could ever have been on this trip — the greater of the STANDARD zone-class fee of 4.00 and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee of 4.00, i.e. 4.00 — was never levied. The rider's claim for the return of the SGD 26.00 therefore cannot be supported under this category, and the charge stands as it presently is (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). The outcome is NO_ACTION.

ON THE ARGUMENTS. The rider's points that POL-NS-01 limb (c) fails (240 s against 300 s, a 70 s shortfall) and limb (d) fails (no termination on RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT) are accepted, and so is the rider's observation that the 26.00 is a completed-trip fare rather than a no-show fee. Those findings are what deny the driver any compensation, but they return no money, because POL-NS-06 refunds only the cancellation-fee line and that line is 0.00. The rider's POL-NS-04 argument is rejected: the single chat message was sent at 15:16:50, ten seconds after the trip started at 15:16:40, so it was not sent 'during the waiting window' as limb (a) requires, and limb (c) cannot be run at all because the trace carries no rider track (rider_fix_count 0) — and in any event POL-NS-04 would also refund only the cancellation-fee line. The driver's points that the driver arrived and held, that the arrival marker is not a false arrival, that POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider, and that no cancellation fee was ever charged are accepted. The driver's conditional request to escalate if the amount cannot be fixed is rejected: NO_ACTION does not require the disputed amount to be fixed, and the deciding fact — that this was a completed trip, not a no-show — is carried independently and at full weight by EV-TRIP-00708, not solely by the fare screen.

EVIDENCE WEIGHTING. EV-FARE-00708 is impaired — weight 0.6, issue code UNVERIFIED_SOURCE (MAJOR), a manually transcribed rider payment screen with no independent ledger corroboration, which the driver expressly disputes — and it is named here for that reason. The ruling does not rest on it: EV-TRIP-00708, at full weight 1.0, independently shows the trip was completed and never cancelled, so confidence is not capped at 0.6 and the impairment does not force escalation under POL-NS-09(a) or (e). Confidence 0.85.

NO REFERRAL is entered: no clause produces one on these facts. The POL-NS-05(ii) false-arrival referral does not fire because qualifying in-geofence fixes do exist, and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (1 no-show termination in 30 days against 110 completed trips).

ONE OPEN POINT FOR THE RIDER, not a referral: if the completed-trip fare of 26.00 was taken although no passenger ever boarded, that is a completed-trip fare dispute, which is a different category from this no-show dispute. Nothing in the no-show policy decides it, and this ruling does not decide it.

But this does not, by itself, return your money: POL-NS-06 and POL-NS-04 refund the cancellation-fee line only, and the fare breakdown records cancellation_fee 0.00. To the driver: your point that no no-show fee was ever charged is well taken, as are your arrival and no-false-marker points (closest approach 1.24 m, 25 qualifying fixes, nothing over 300 m or at 15 km/h at the marker). But the character and amount of the contested SGD 26.00 rest entirely on EV-FARE-00708, and that artifact is impaired: weight_multiplier 0.6, issue code UNVERIFIED_SOURCE (a manually transcribed payment screen with no ledger corroboration), which you yourself dispute. EV-TRIP-00708 and EV-GPS-00708 (both weight 1.0) establish the arrival, dwell and completion facts; neither carries the charge. The deciding fact is therefore carried solely by evidence at 0.6 — below the 0.65 automatic-escalation threshold and below the 0.70 platform floor — so my confidence is capped at 0.6 and is below the floor. The case escalates under POL-NS-09(a), and the sole-evidence impairment engages POL-NS-09(e) read with POL-NS-08; the fare breakdown also fails POL-NS-08(d) on its face (cancellation-fee line 0.00 against a fee_schedule resolution-rule amount of SGD 4.00 for a STANDARD RYDE_X trip). This is not a finding for either side. The disputed SGD 26.00 is held, not collected or refunded, while review is pending. The reviewer's open questions: fix the true character and amount of the SGD 26.00 — is it a completed-trip fare (base fare 3.80 + distance fare 14.90 + time fare 6.50 + platform fee 0.80 = 26.00, as the fare breakdown records) or a no-show charge; whether it should stand at all given that no passenger boarded a trip the platform nevertheless marked COMPLETED; and what became of the waiting-period and termination handling on this trip.

ruling.explanation: To both parties — this case goes to a human reviewer, and no money moves for now: the disputed SGD 26.00 is held, neither collected nor refunded. What is established. This was a STANDARD-zone pickup, so a no-show fee requires the driver to hold inside the pickup geofence for a continuous 300 seconds, counted from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the 'arrived' tap. EV-GPS-00708 shows the driver's longest qualifying in-geofence run at 240 seconds, with accumulated dwell of 230 seconds — a 70-second shortfall against the 300-second minimum. The only route to sum a second interval is a present traffic advisory of a qualifying type, and EV-ADVIS-00708-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0), so nothing bridges the gap. EV-TRIP-00708 also shows the trip as COMPLETED with no cancellation reason code, so the no-show termination limb fails as well. I therefore accept the rider's limb (c) and limb (d) points, and the POL-NS-06 consequence that no no-show cancellation fee was chargeable, and the driver's points that the driver genuinely arrived (25 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m radius, closest approach 1.24 m) and that the arrival marker was not false — so no POL-NS-05(ii) false-arrival referral is entered, and no driver compensation is payable because POL-NS-01 is not made out. Why this does not yet produce a refund. The SGD 26.00 the rider contests is not recorded as a cancellation fee: EV-FARE-00708 shows cancellation_fee 0.00 and the 26.00 as a completed-trip fare — base 3.80 + distance 14.90 + time 6.50 + platform 0.80 = 26.00 — and POL-NS-06 refunds the cancellation-fee line only, of which there is none. The one artifact that states the 26.00 is that manually transcribed payment screen, EV-FARE-00708, weight_multiplier 0.6 with issue code UNVERIFIED_SOURCE (no independent ledger export corroborates it), and the driver disputes it. Because the amount rests on that single impaired screen, my confidence is capped at 0.6, below the platform's 0.70 floor, so POL-NS-09(a) requires escalation: I cannot fix the sum on reliable evidence and will not guess it. The other points. The rider's POL-NS-04 argument is partly with the rider — limbs (a) and (b) plausibly hold and limb (c) cannot be run because the trace carries no rider track, which POL-NS-04 makes neutral — but that clause, too, refunds only the cancellation fee (0.00), so it does not fix the amount. The driver's contention that no cancellation fee was charged, and the NO_ACTION disposition urged on it, is well taken as far as it goes, but it rests on the same unverified screen, and I cannot confidently leave the rider charged SGD 26.00 on evidence this tribunal cannot check. Open question for the reviewer: establish the true ledger position — what was actually charged, and was the SGD 26.00 a legitimate completed-trip fare or a charge for a pickup at which no passenger boarded? Both the driver's statement that the passengers 'were confused and walked away' and the rider's 15:16:50 message that the parents were 'still at the pickup' indicate nobody boarded, and the trip covers only 1.3 km. If the charge is not a legitimate completed fare, it should be refunded.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: I cannot fix the money in this case, so the disputed SGD 26.00 is held — it is neither refunded to the rider nor released to the driver — and the file goes to a human reviewer under POL-NS-09. Here is the reasoning, and the figures it uses.

What the technical records settle. EV-TRIP-00708 (weight 1.0) shows the trip marked COMPLETED, with cancelled_at, cancelled_by and cancellation_reason_code all empty. No no-show/cancellation was processed, so on this record there is no cancellation fee for the no-show rules to return: POL-NS-01 limb (d) is not made out, and there is nothing in a POL-NS-06 refund line to give back. The waiting clock independently falls short as well. The pickup zone is STANDARD, so the required continuous in-geofence dwell is 300 seconds; EV-GPS-00708 (weight 1.0) shows a longest qualifying in-geofence run of 240 seconds (230 seconds accumulated) — a 70-second shortfall — so POL-NS-01 limb (c) fails too. The rider's limb (c) and POL-NS-06 shortfall claims and the driver's answer to them are therefore both right that the cancellation-fee line is SGD 0.00, and the no-show clauses refund that line only; the rider's further point that the rider should not be left carrying a completed-trip fare is noted but is not something those clauses reach.

What is not settled: the amount. The only record of the SGD 26.00 is EV-FARE-00708, and it is impaired — weight_multiplier 0.60, issue code UNVERIFIED_SOURCE (MAJOR): a manually transcribed payment screen, not a verified ledger export, and the driver expressly disputes it. Its own figures are a 0.00 cancellation fee against a 26.00 total (base fare 3.80 + distance fare 14.90 + time fare 6.50 + platform fee 0.80), and the platform's money derivation reports a -4.00 reconciliation gap against the 4.00 that a STANDARD RYDE_X no-show would produce. Under POL-GEN-02 the finding is down-weighted: the artifact may be used, but it cannot carry a ruling alone.

Why escalation. Every number that decides what the rider is owed comes from that one impaired artifact, and nothing independent states the amount — the trip record shows a trip was completed but records no money. Under POL-GEN-02(2) my confidence is therefore capped at 0.60, below the platform-wide floor of 0.70 read from the policy, and POL-NS-09(a) requires escalation; because the fare line is also the sole evidence of the amount, POL-NS-09(e) points the same way. Whether the artifact is additionally impaired under POL-NS-08 I need not finally resolve (the 0.00 line does not reconcile with the 4.00 schedule); the POL-GEN-02 cap applies regardless.

The open question for the reviewer: both the rider's filing and the driver's statement ('the passengers were confused and walked away') indicate no passenger boarded, yet the trip was marked COMPLETED and 26.00 charged. The reviewer must decide what that SGD 26.00 is — a completed-trip fare for a journey nobody took, which sits outside the no-show fee schedule and needs a refund decision the automated pipeline cannot make, or a chargeable amount — before any money moves.

On the remaining claims: the driver did arrive and hold at the pin (25 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD radius, closest approach 1.24 m), so POL-NS-05's false-arrival route does not open and no false-arrival referral is entered. POL-NS-04 is moot: whether the rider's 15:16:50 message fell inside the waiting window (the trip started 15:16:40) and whether limb (c) is undecidable because the trace carries no rider track (rider_fix_count 0), the clause can only refund a cancellation fee, and none was charged. POL-NS-06's accumulation route is unavailable because the advisory EV-ADVIS-00708-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT). The driver's request for NO_ACTION is declined: NO_ACTION rests on fare_breakdown.payment_status and refund_issued_sgd, which sit in the same impaired artifact, and the amount cannot be confirmed. The driver's request to hold rather than refund is granted, and that is what escalation does. No referral is entered: POL-NS-05(ii) requires a false arrival (none exists), and POL-NS-07's anti-farming branch does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d is 1 and the rate is 1/110 = 0.009).

ledger.claim: The baseline no-show fee is chargeable only if all four POL-NS-01 conditions hold, and limb (c) fails on the driver's own telemetry. The pickup zone class is STANDARD (trip_record.pickup_zone_class), so the required continuous in-geofence dwell is 300 seconds, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix rather than from the 'arrived' tap. The trace's longest qualifying in-geofence run is 240 seconds, from 2026-09-23T15:12:50 to 15:16:50, and its accumulated in-geofence dwell is 230 seconds - a shortfall of 70 seconds. Because the driver did not hold position for the required minimum, limb (c) is broken and the fee is not chargeable under this clause.

POL-NS-06 then directs the remedy: where the effective in-geofence dwell is shorter than the POL-NS-01 minimum for the zone class, the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider answered messages. Required 300 seconds for STANDARD, measured 240 seconds (accumulated 230), shortfall 70 seconds as computed on the trace. The only qualification, limb (i) accumulation, is unavailable here: EV-ADVIS-00708-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 and issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, and POL-NS-06(i) requires a present and populated advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT before separate in-geofence intervals may be summed. No advisory exists, so nothing bridges the shortfall and nothing excuses it. The charge is refunded in full.

Limb (d) of POL-NS-01 fails as well. The trip record shows cancellation_reason_code null, cancelled_by null, cancelled_at null and status COMPLETED. There is no termination by the driver on RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT, and no boarding event is recorded anywhere on the trip. The driver's own counterparty statement does not assert that anyone boarded - it says the passengers 'were confused and walked away'. With limb (d) unsatisfied, no no-show fee is chargeable under POL-NS-01 at all, and the charge taken from the rider cannot stand as an itemised cancellation fee.

POL-NS-04 independently exonerates the rider and refunds the fee in full with no driver compensation payable. Limb (a): the chat log holds the rider's message sent at 2026-09-23T15:16:50 - 'My parents are still at the pickup. Did anyone board?' - which is both a statement of the riders' position and a request for the driver's position, and it was sent while the driver was still inside the geofence, his qualifying run ending at the same moment. Limb (b): the driver neither replied in the chat within 120 seconds of that message nor placed any in-app voice call - trip_record.in_app_calls is empty - before the trip ended at 15:20:40. Limb (c) cannot be run at all because the trace carries no rider track (rider_fix_count 0), and POL-NS-04 makes an absent rider track UNDECIDABLE and neutral: it is expressly neither satisfied nor failed, and the Judge must not infer from it that the rider was elsewhere. On limbs (a) and (b), with (c) neutral, the fee is refunded in full.

The sum actually taken is not a no-show fee, and I disclose the impairment rather than present it clean: EV-FARE-00708 carries weight_multiplier 0.6 and issue code UNVERIFIED_SOURCE (MAJOR) - a manually transcribed rider payment screen with no independent ledger corroboration, which the driver also disputes. On its face it shows cancellation_fee 0.00 alongside total_charged 26.00, composed of base_fare 3.80, distance_fare 14.90, time_fare 6.50 and platform_fee 0.80: a completed-trip fare, not a cancellation fee, and its own money derivation reports a schedule fee of 4.00 against a fee charged of 0.00. Even on the driver's best case, the chargeable no-show fee for a STANDARD RYDE_X trip under POL-NS-01 and fee_schedule.resolution_rule is the greater of the zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) - SGD 4.00. The rider should not be left carrying a completed-trip fare for a trip on which no passenger boarded.

POL-GEN-02 permits ESCALATE where a deciding fact rests solely on an artifact at or below weight 0.65, as here. Escalation holds the disputed SGD 26 rather than collecting or refunding it, so the rider is not left carrying a charge the platform cannot substantiate. Either way the rider should not bear this charge.

ledger.claim: The rider asks the tribunal to return 'this platform charge', but no no-show fee was ever charged on this trip. EV-FARE-00708 records cancellation_fee 0.00 and the derived money block records fee_charged 0.00, while the SGD 26.00 is made up of base fare 3.80 + distance fare 14.90 + time fare 6.50 + platform fee 0.80 on a trip that EV-TRIP-00708 shows as COMPLETED. POL-NS-01 licenses only NO_ACTION or DRIVER_COMPENSATION, and POL-NS-06 refunds the cancellation-fee line and nothing else ('refund the cancellation-fee line only, not any booking or platform fee'); where there is no cancellation-fee line there is nothing for the no-show policy to return to the rider. EV-FARE-00708 is impaired - weight 0.6, issue code UNVERIFIED_SOURCE - and I rely on it only for the arithmetic it records.

The rider's own filing concedes that the only proof of the disputed amount is 'a manually transcribed payment screen, not a verified ledger export', and the admissibility pre-pass tagged EV-FARE-00708 IMPAIRED with issue code UNVERIFIED_SOURCE at weight 0.6. Under POL-GEN-02 an artifact below 0.70 that is the sole carrier of a deciding fact caps confidence beneath the platform-wide 0.70 floor, so the rider's own evidence cannot carry a refund against the driver; the driver has expressly disputed this same artifact in his statement.

The driver did arrive and hold at the pickup. EV-GPS-00708 records 25 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius in a single continuous in-geofence run of 240 seconds, with a minimum recorded distance to the pickup pin of 1.24 m. This is a driver who was physically present at the pickup point and waited there - not a driver who never came.

The arrival marker is not a false arrival under POL-NS-05. The trace's closest approach to the pin is 1.24 m, the in-geofence fixes report 0.0 kph, and nothing in EV-GPS-00708 places the driver more than 300 m from the pickup pin, or travelling at 15 km/h or above, at the moment the marker was set. The false-arrival refund route is not open on this record and no false-arrival referral can be entered against the driver.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider. The single chat message was sent at 15:16:50, ten seconds AFTER the trip started at 15:16:40, so it was not sent 'during the waiting window' as limb (a) requires; and limb (c) is undecidable because EV-GPS-00708 carries no rider track at all (rider_fix_count 0), which POL-NS-04 expressly treats as neutral rather than satisfied. With limb (a) not made out and limb (c) not made out, the clause does not apply and the dispute is decided under POL-NS-01.

The present state of this trip is a charge of SGD 26.00 with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. On this record the rider's claim is not supported: no cancellation fee exists to refund and the only evidence of the amount is impaired and disputed. Under POL-GEN-03 the disposition is NO_ACTION, which leaves the charge exactly as it presently stands. EV-FARE-00708 is impaired - weight 0.6, issue code UNVERIFIED_SOURCE - and I cite it only for the recorded payment state.

If the tribunal concludes it cannot fix the disputed amount on the evidence before it, the outcome should still not be a refund. The sole artifact carrying the amount, EV-FARE-00708, is impaired (weight 0.6, issue code UNVERIFIED_SOURCE) and is disputed by the driver, so the amount should be placed on hold for human review under POL-NS-09 rather than returned. Escalation holds the disputed amount; it does not refund it.
